query_text: Sign up for a photography course at the community center

messages.content: Sign up for a photography course at the community center

message.content:
A **photography course at the community center** is available through the City of Pembroke Pines’ Carl Shechter Southwest Focal Point Community Center Campus, with photography classes listed for adults 18+ and registration described as ongoing.[2][3]

To sign up, you would need to register with the center and, for some classes, present a free membership card; the Activities Desk can be reached at **954-450-6888** for class and registration questions.[2]

If you want, I can help you identify the **best matching class**, or draft a short **registration message/call script** for the center.
